summary: Garfield County Search and Rescue, searching for a missing person, located human remains near Fravert Reservoir off County Road 244; the remains were identified as Raul Perez, whose body had been there since mid-summer; the death was investigated as a homicide and four people were charged in April 2024.
location: Fravert Reservoir, off County Road 244, near Rifle
notes: Date is the remains-found date per the id-3865 precedent; body had been there since mid-summer; death investigated as homicide, four charged 2024-04-02; source = Sopris Sun Scuttlebutt/Calendar published 2024-04-10, citing a Garfield County Sheriff's Office press release; Dec 26, 2023 was a Tuesday.
